capabilities: Edit a link's display text in a pop-up
Edit the target and the text together in one two-field pop-up
Alt + click a link to edit it in Reading view, Live Preview and source mode
Edit external link addresses and titles
Write links in properties back through the frontmatter as valid YAML
disambiguation: Not only display text: it also edits a link's target URL, and it works on links stored in note properties.
extras: Documentation is a demo vault that ships with each release and can be opened with a command; beta builds are installed through BRAT.
problem: Changing what a link says means hand-editing raw wikilink or Markdown syntax, and Reading view offers no way to do it without switching modes.

relations.evidence: Same goal, different UI: a pop-up for the alias and the target
Same goal: pop-up link editing; opens on Alt + click, so plain click still navigates
Covers part of it: link editing only, for every link kind
Same goal, different UI: a pop-up instead of selecting raw text
Covers part of it: also wikilinks, properties and Reading view

summary: Pop-up link editor that changes a link's display text, or its target and text together, across wikilinks, Markdown links, external links and properties.
